messages:
Carmen: Postmortem follow-up: transient latency and retries during the 03:12 window traced to a combination of route map flips + DNS TTL experiments. Symptoms: TLS rejects on reused sessions -> client retry -> cross-region fallback.
Drew: Any solid repro?
Carmen: Yes, reproducer attached in gist (sanitized) and a short log excerpt: 
```
[2026-03-12T03:12:10Z] edge: session_reuse=true sni=svc.customer TLS_REJECT backend=grn-edge-2
[2026-03-12T03:12:11Z] dns: record-update name=svc.customer ttl=5 old_ip=10.2.3.4 new_ip=10.2.3.8
[2026-03-12T03:12:12Z] route: route-map-swap old=grn-edge-2 new=grn-edge-6
[2026-03-12T03:12:13Z] lb: fallback cross_region to us-east-1
```
Nadia: From the traces, ~2-3% of flows hit this. Most recover, but extra 300-700ms.
Drew: Proposed mitigations?
Carmen: Short-term: pause low-TTL DNS experiments during route-map rollouts; add a brief safety-hold when active session_reuse > X. Medium: implement SNI eviction on session cache when route map updates. Long-term: atomic route-map and SNI mapping swap.
infra-bot: scheduled job created: "disable-low-ttl-experiments" triggered for rollout windows.
Carmen: Can we assign owners and deadlines so I can update the postmortem?
Drew: I'll own the SNI eviction change in net-runtime. ETA 2026-04-05 EOD.
Nadia: I'll add a regression test in CI that replicates dns flip + session reuse. ETA 2026-03-30.
Carmen: Ops action: I'll update the runbook and gate experiments (ETA 2026-03-24).
oncall-sre: I'll add an alert for "tls_reject_retry_rate" with a 1m burn-in and page-on > 10/min. ETA 2026-03-25 AM.
Drew: Note for rollout: when enabling eviction, do canary in one region and keep --sni-allowlist toggle to avoid mass rejects.
Carmen: Perfect. Recap of action items:
- Drew: implement session SNI eviction + tests (2026-04-05)
- Nadia: CI harness + regression test (2026-03-30)
- Carmen: runbook update + experiment gating (2026-03-24)
- oncall-sre: alert + paging config (2026-03-25)
- infra-bot: schedule disable-low-ttl-experiments during rollouts (done)

Carmen: Please react with :white_check_mark: when tickets/PRs exist so I can link them to the postmortem.
Drew: :white_check_mark:
Nadia: :white_check_mark:
oncall-sre: :white_check_mark:
Carmen: Thanks. I'll add these to the PM and schedule a 30m sync next week to verify rollout results. If anyone spots similar TLS anomalies tied to DNS changes, tag #incidents and @Carmen.
